descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name (short form of Yehonadab, H3082), referring to Jonadab son of Shimeah (David's nephew, 2 Samuel 13) and also associated with Jonadab son of Rechab. With 7 occurrences, all three clusters represent the same proper noun in different grammatical frames: nominative (eng 'Jonadab/Yonadav,' spa 'Yonadab/Yonadav,' arb 'يونَدابُ/يُونَادَابُ,' kor '요나답,' swa 'Yonadabu,' hin 'योनादाब'), with lamed-preposition ('to Yonadav'), and with conjunction ('and Jonadab'). No semantic differentiation; purely syntactic variation.
